build_kimi_vl_model: build a KimiVLForConditionalGeneration model with vision tower, projector, and language model for multimodal inference
create_multimodal_projector: create a KimiVLMultiModalProjector that transforms vision features into text embedding space using layered linear projections
run_multimodal_processor: run KimiVLMultiModalProcessor to replace image tokens with computed token counts and build multi-modal field configs
test_image_token_count: test KimiVLProcessingInfo.get_num_image_tokens to compute output token count from image dimensions and kernel size
generate_dummy_inputs: generate dummy text and multi-modal data for KimiVL model testing with configurable image counts and dimensions
